notes.title: 🌷Academy Greenhouse, new classroom, NPC Schedules and more!🌷
notes.notes:
April brings new magic to Kitori Academy! 🌷

We've been working hard these past months, brewing tons of new features and improvements for Kitori Academy. The magic is starting to come alive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/273ab7f49a4fdc7ce839309abd51697cee2d1406.png[/img]
[h3][u]🌱Greenhouse and botanic classroom🌱[/u][/h3]
Little by little, we’re filling the Academy with classrooms, hidden rooms, hallways, and exciting secrets waiting to be discovered.

Our latest addition? The Greenhouse! 🌿✨ This is where players will dive into the world of crops, plants, and harvesting. Just like the other classrooms, it will have:

🕰️ Scheduled Classes – Attend at the right time to participate!
👩‍🏫 A Dedicated Teacher – Ready to guide you through your botanical journey.
🎁 Fun Rewards! – Expect seeds, buffs for your crops, and other surprises.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/afa7db06b686a89acb61f9293462e3dde8da927d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/287ac97ff0918c982bba5b4025e7a3f16eb7bfdf.png[/img]

[h3][u]✨NPC Schedule✨[/u][/h3]
One of the most overwhelmingly popular requests from our community has been to make the academy's students feel truly alive, creating a more immersive and vibrant world for players to explore.

For the past months, we have been working on the NPC system to make the Apprentices NPC feel like real people walking. So, for this huge task, we've added a few more exciting things:

✨They have their schedules during the day; they have a stack of behaviours that are selected depending on the weather, the day of the week and other conditions.

🗣️They can also interact with other NPCs and talk among themselves (just like in real life!)

🪑They also do other things, such as sitting on benches and leaning on walls.

We hope to have this system more refined and show you a little video of how it looks. For now, you can look at these pictures; we use those dummies to simulate these behaviours and save them in memory but don't worry, they will become proper NPCs when the player is around!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/39f6c76053b89cef39be99bb75d99cebfaf3568c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/eebba69b5dce03d365fdbdf64318c5d9af1f9c65.jpg[/img]

[h3][u]🌟Miscellaneous Updates!🌟[/u][/h3]

NPCs now appear in class cinematic when players decide to start a class to keep up with their magical studies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/649f54029f244df828bc76818ff73fe9da18cc18.png[/img]
We've added 4 new crops, but as you can observe in the picture, they are not regular crops; we enjoy taking vegetables and fruits and giving them a little twist.
In the following picture, we have crops that could resemble berries, turnips and peppers.
Currently we have a mixture of special and regular crops!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/00d38d3b24427a14783ffa7864e27e8c03861658.png[/img]

notes.title: 🏰New spells, new interiors and unexpected events!🏰
notes.notes:

This has always been in the game, but it needed some integration with the rest of the game systems. We are also creating content for this feature, the UI, and 3D assets, which is progressing very well.🎨🛠️
These unexpected events will involve casting spells✨🔮 crafting, little demons... you will see.👀

notes.title: ✨Baby ranch creatures & Lots of new Crops!✨
notes.notes:
Hello, aspiring apprentices!🐉
In this blog, we have even more creatures in the world of Kitori Academy. This time, they are babies! 🐣

[h3][u]🐉Baby fruit dragons🐉[/u][/h3]
Last time, we showed you the adorable dragons that rest on the trees. The dragons are born from eggs and grow to adulthood along with the tree!
Dragons don't require much attention, but they enjoy a healthy snack and the occasional pet; most of the time, they guard the fruit trees and just be nice little pets to brighten your garden.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/ddc4e0f520628d4d578c7658039cd96b76452e52.png[/img]

But this blog has more cuteness; we also have Jackalope babies 🐇 and Owl babies🦉!
You can care for these babies so they grow strong and happy by petting and feeding them.
We're adding a birth system 🐣 and creatures can become sick as well.

notes.title: ✨It's all about dragons!✨
notes.notes:
Hi there, future apprentices!
We've been busy adding new creatures, such as fruit dragons, these past months!!

[h3][u]🐉🍓Fruit Dragons🍓🐉[/u][/h3]
You might remember from previous updates that Kitori Academy's world is filled with cute creatures like owls and jackalopes. 
And even more special, you can care for them in the ranch creatures; you can feed and pet them and ensure their homes are clean and tidy.
We went beyond that and added a new type of creature: fruit dragons!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/48573a3772bbc40ca453d87481bb2325c8795649.png[/img]

You will be able to raise and care for these adorable dragons as part of the Ranch.
You can think of them as what you might see in other farming games with trees but with a twist.
They won't require as much attention as the other creatures, but they will still need food and sometimes pets...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/c84330992fd43d3d30d06e3699e5b2f0b64c48f2.png[/img]

The tree starts with a dragon egg and a tiny sprout.
Soon after, a tree will fully grow, and your dragon will guard it patiently.
Giving them fish is your task; you will receive fruits and other gifts.

[h3][u]🏕️Improved the ranch creature homes🏕️ [/u][/h3]
We've decided to polish the aspect of the creature's homes, and this new direction looks much better.
This is how they used to look:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/625c5767769fb6542f5501cb9261b6d3147091d5.png[/img]
And here is how they look now! (You can enter the houses)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/e23e7cc31403c0400a74186cae1bd68ebadc7108.png[/img]

notes.title: ✨New Spells, Front Academy visuals update and more✨
notes.notes:
Happy New Year, all!
Here is a round-up of all the new things we've been adding to Kitori Academy since the last update.

[h3][u]🧙Absorbing Spells and other sparks🧙[/u][/h3]
Several times, we've presented you with the fire spirits, which will help you with your daily endeavours as a wizard in training.
One of the curious characteristics of these little naughty fires is you can't hold them with your bare hands!
For this reason, you will have to use the absorbing spell you will learn in class.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/ff9cf4551470452370e483e7000477a8fd358943.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=yDQ_adlciTs;full][/previewyoutube]

Here is another fun spell we've implemented. Now, you can remove weeds in the garden with the fire spell!
[previewyoutube=5XSlaLac12M;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][u]📜Gameplay Quests and NPCs!📜 [/u][/h3]
We implemented the initial quest system a few months ago and created some basic, simple quests.
Since then, we've been improving this system with more complex quests that involve talking to NPCs, crafting potions, finding places, etc. It's progressing very well and giving Kitori Academy a richer gameplay experience.
We are very excited about this.

Alongside the quest system, we've implemented daily schedules for the NPC that live in the apprentice town.
NPC has their daily schedules and wander around the Town freely; we want to keep improving this system so every corner of the world feels alive.

[h3][u]✨ Front Academy visual improvements ✨[/u][/h3]
We've made some improvements to the front academy, we've changed the windows and the aspect of the walls.

notes.title: ✨Owls, the apothecary shopkeeper and the freshly baked new HUD!✨
notes.notes:
[h3][u]Owls, owls, owls 🦉🦉🦉...[/u][/h3]
In this update, we want to show you the new creature of the Ranch: Owls!
We want to include different types of owls you can care for on the Ranch, and here is one of them: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/6e48b67866153d820786e123422af92893778c14.png[/img]

We've also implemented the following features to the ranch system:
You can build different houses for your creatures in dedicated spaces near your cottage.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/64c3202083ae5e16317c0602c071341292c5b055.png[/img]
[list]

[*] Owls, Rabbits and more creatures to come will wander around these houses and will have different states. For example, the owls sleep during the day and are more active when the sun goes down
[*] Rabbits sleep at night and are graciously livid, jumping and running during the day.
[*] All creatures will take cover when it's raining! 
[/list]
You will have to put food on their houses, clean them and interact with the creatures.

[h3][u]🐈The Apothecary Shopkeeper🐈[/u][/h3]
We have a special guest on this blog: The quirky Apothecary shopkeeper!
You will find this intriguing character if you pass by the apothecary shop in the apprentice town.
The shopkeeper will happily sell you seeds, ingredients, and other witchy trinkets for your journey to become a wizard.
You might remember that the shopkeeper is not just the regular shopkeeper; it hides a (well, it's not so well-hidden) fluffy secret under their attire...👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/b04f216984363560ef21243298c0e6a0df84db9f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/d713be1c6ad2c269fe56e449f530a5ebedcc3d64.png[/img]

[h3][u]🤗Last but not least, the HUD!🤗[/u][/h3]
In the following pictures, you can see the player interface, with a clock on the right side, which indicates the time of day, the weather, and the date...  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/6efce7d4e0226729a0aea5554dbada05d3f95c68.jpg[/img]

We've added a broom indicator that will tell you whether you can ride the broom in certain areas.  At the bottom, there are 2 different hot bars, the hot bar for items and a secondary hot bar for the spells.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/efeeca505fc78e85bf888e9e915d67d4c2d3c679.jpg[/img]

We've also added a mana indicator, indicating how much mana you have left to use with spells. Look at the new interface for the inventory and workstation such as the cauldron.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/b625f51a24210eb9935d96f197833794e391d209.png[/img]

notes.title: The Apothecary, fire spirit house and more...✨
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Welcome to June's dev blog![/b][/h2]
Hey there!

In this dev blog, we have lots of new things to show you. Enjoy!

[h2][u]✨ The Apothecary ✨[/u][/h2]

We've been working on a new building for Apprentice's Town, the Apothecary.

The Apothecary is a handy shop where you can buy all sorts of seeds, materials and raw ingredients, so you can keep practising your witchy skills and advance in your lessons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/aef1f4378bd44bda31bf29e6f430d02ebab99d0c.png[/img]

We have a curious feline at night time...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/3bf6ddffb16012414488502cdae8662f74ecfdfc.png[/img]

[h2][u] 🔥 The spirit house and the Shed🔥[/u][/h2]

Do you remember those little spirit fires that help you with your potions? Well, they deserve to have their own space!

We've completed the spirit houses, where the fire spells are chilling out, waiting for you to use them under the cauldron.

We also want to show you the Shed, a dedicated space where you can build spirit houses, cauldrons and other workstations. This Shed is located in the back garden, and it will be an essential place whenever you want to practice your witchy skills and feel like going outside the academy. 

[previewyoutube=2U-bWH-ROuw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][u]🧙 Town Folks 🧙🏽‍♀️[/u][/h2]

We've been populating the Apprentice Town with some apprentices scattered around the corners of the Town..

We want to make Apprentice Town and the rest of the areas in the world of Kitori feel alive; for that, we will have simple NPCs wandering around minding their own business. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/d1535798840743fa0024d188b4798c8a00fc4f8d.png[/img]

 There will be a few fluffy surprises; if you take a peaceful stroll, you might spot a feline friend up in the ceiling buildings.

Let's take a look! 👀

[h2][u]🏕️The apprentice Town🏕️[/u][/h2]

This area is a little town outside the academy, where your cosy cottage is located. It will feature a variety of houses, a town square, a river and some hidden paths and secrets.
Other apprentices and common townfolks will live in this area as well.
The apprentice town is the area between the academy and the valley, and it will allow you to enjoy your time while you are not learning new spells, potions or other witchy things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/8ab280dc0b0158226523e13efe626b1711e26748.png[/img]

[h2][u] 🐇The creature ranch 🐇[/u][/h2]

We are so excited about this new feature! On the back of your cottage, there is a nice area to grow crops, but! You can also place little houses for critters like horned rabbits, owls and bees!
It goes like this; you can place a cute shelter for creatures you must take care for. They will give you resources to craft potions or other witchy things in exchange. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/9e1e802b8d6ef445cc4077f5f136a1f3dcd41548.png[/img]

[h2][u]🎮Steam Deck 🎮[/u][/h2]

We got our hands on a Steam Deck a while ago, and promptly we exported a first build on this console to test. And Kitori Academy will be completely compatible!
From the beginning of the development of this game, we've put a lot of effort into ensuring the game runs smoothly on consoles such as Steam Deck and Nintendo Switch.
We've also made sure you can enjoy your favourite cosy witchy game with a controller, mouse, and keyboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/c023615659c0c2fb28d0c66ac191de01eae7a087.png[/img]

[h2][u]Alexandra and her Honduran Bat familiars[/u][/h2]
I would like to formally present you to the first possible character you will be able to be best friends with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39685020/fcec1077fcc8464f529eb448f7c1d39634ea720a.png[/img]

notes.title: Be an adorable magic school student in Witchery Academy
